THIS CRIMINAL MISC. CASE HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 06.11.2025, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY PASSED THE FOLLOWING:
 Crl.M.C.No.7139/2025  3  2025:KER:84200  ORDER Dated this the 6th day of November, 2025

This is a petition filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, by the 1st accused in Crime No.755/2024 of Viyyoor Police Station, Thrissur which is pending as CC. No.1088/2024 on the file of Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I,
Thrissur.

Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I,
Thrissur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The offence alleged against the petitioners is punishable under Section(s) 498A IPC.
2.

The prosecution case is that the accused being the husband of the defacto complainant subjected her to cruelty both physically and mentally on the ground of dowry and thereby they alleged to have committed the aforesaid offence.
3. According to the petitioner, the dispute has been settled with the defacto complainant and they agreed to drop all further proceedings relating to the above dispute.
Therefore, the petitioner prayed for quashing all further proceedings against him.
4. The Defacto complainant filed affidavit endorsing the averments in the Criminal MC.
According to her, the case has been amicably settled and that she does not intend to proceed with the case and also that further proceedings in the case can be quashed.
She has no further grievance against the petitioner.

The learned Public Prosecutor, after getting instruction from the investigating officer also submitted that the dispute has been settled between the parties and that the victim is not at all interested in continuing the prosecution against the petitioner.

sentences.text: Considering the fact that the offence involved in this case are not heinous and very serious, but purely of private in nature and now the dispute has been settled between the parties, this is a fit case in which further proceedings can be quashed by invoking the inherent power of this court.
Such a course is also required to maintain the harmonious relationship between the parties to a marriage and also to prevent abuse of process of the court.
7. In the result, this Crl. M.C is allowed.
All further proceedings against the petitioner in CC.

No.1088/2024 on the file of Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I, Thrissur arising from Crime No.755/2024 of Viyyoor Police Station, Thrissur, stands quashed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
